title: The drive
situation: You are {{Kara}}, in the back of {{Rose}}’s car with {{Alice}} against you. It is November 9th, 2038, 9:34 PM. {{Rose}} is driving you across {{Detroit}} in the dark toward a place where androids are said to be safe. You can look out of the window, change the station on the car radio, or simply wait while she drives.

situationWhen.text: {{Luther}} sits beside you, watching the road.
The radio is playing music now.

options.text: LOOK OUTSIDE: look out of the window at the city.
options.fact: {{Rose}} told you the authorities have been conducting raids all over the city, and that everybody is on edge after what happened yesterday.
options.outcome: {{Kara}} looks out at the dark, empty streets. {{Rose}}: “They’ve been conducting raids all over the city… Everybody is on edge after what happened yesterday… It’s gonna be all right. We’re almost there.”

options.text: CHANGE RADIO STATION: turn the dial on the car radio.
options.fact: The radio said that, with all androids being turned over to the authorities, the country is grinding to a halt: hospitals and schools are closing, water cuts, blackouts and network failures are expected, and the armed forces have lost two thirds of their personnel, which were android models.
options.outcome: {{KNC}}, {{RosannaCartland}}: “With all androids being turned over to the authorities, the country is grinding to a halt. Hospitals and schools are closing. Water cuts, blackouts, and network failures are expected. Maybe most worrying of all, our armed forces have lost two thirds of their effective personnel, which consisted of specialized android models. The situation is extremely alarming.” {{Rose}}: “How about some music instead?”

options.text: WAIT: let {{Rose}} drive on to the stop.
options.outcome: {{Kara}} sits back and holds {{Alice}} close. After a while {{Rose}} turns into a deserted parking lot by the river and stops the car.

adaptationNote: The chart’s DRIVING TO {{JERICHO}} WITH {{ALICE}} checkpoint (or … WITH {{ALICE}} & {{LUTHER}}, if {{Luther}} survived Midnight Train), the optional LOOK OUTSIDE and CHANGE RADIO STATION and the PARKING LOT event, as a small repeatable scene: each optional action can be taken once, and WAIT ends the drive at the parking lot.
